AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.description: What this Next.js starter kit contains, the decisions it makes for you, and what it deliberately leaves out.
AboutPage.lead: A production-ready Next.js starting point: multilingual, light and dark themes, shadcn/ui components, containerization and continuous deployment already wired. Clone it, change one config file, ship.
AboutPage.stackIntro: The versions below are read from the project's package.json at build time, so they stay accurate after an upgrade — including in your own copy after cloning.
AboutPage.decisionsIntro: A starter kit is a set of decisions. Leaving them unsaid forces every project to rediscover them — and to wonder whether they were deliberate.
AboutPage.decisionI18nBody: Adding internationalization to an existing project means revisiting every route and every string. Here it is in place from the outset: French and English, a default language, and the routing that goes with it.
AboutPage.decisionDockerTitle: Two Docker images, Node and Bun
AboutPage.decisionDockerBody: Pick your runtime without rewriting the deployment. The continuous integration workflow builds the image and publishes it.
AboutPage.decisionShadcnTitle: shadcn/ui rather than a component library
AboutPage.decisionShadcnBody: The component code is yours: you edit it directly, instead of working around someone else's choices with overrides.
AboutPage.decisionPnpmTitle: pnpm, with a lockfile that rules
AboutPage.decisionPnpmBody: The lockfile determines which versions get installed, and dependency build scripts are approved explicitly rather than run by default.
AboutPage.excludedBody: The kit ships no authentication, no database, no payments and no error monitoring. Those are architectural choices that belong to you, and bundling them here would hand you dependencies you never picked. The kit stops where your decisions begin.
AboutPage.excludedDetectedNone: None of those layers were detected in the dependencies.
AboutPage.excludedCaveat: This check matches a curated list of common packages and cannot be exhaustive. A project built on a tool the list does not know about would not show up here. When in doubt, the package.json is what counts.
AboutPage.demoBody: Switch the language or the theme in the header: what you see is what the kit ships, with no extra setup. The page you are reading uses the very same internationalization and theming you will get.
AboutPage.startBody: Two commands are enough to run the project locally.
AboutPage.startConfigBody: The site name, addresses, social links and metadata live in a single file: src/config/app.ts. That is the only place to edit to make this template your own.
